title: Chen Nian's Whereabouts
next_chapter_hook: Although the prying aura from the direction of the imperial capital was temporarily obscured by the Demonic Path mist, the faint resonance between the Tianji Record and the Dragon Vein had already stirred ripples in the perception of a certain supreme existence—Chen Ji's time was running out faster than he had imagined.

text.content: In the Void of the Tianji Record, the thread of fate wrapped around Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly, the pale golden light echoing distantly with a faint purple-gold hue, as if spanning thousands of rivers and mountains, tightly connected across an invisible dimension. Mr. Mo's low voice resounded from the depths of the Void: 'The threads of fate have intertwined. Can you sense it? That bond belonging to Chen Nian... has become even clearer than before.'

dialogue.content: 'Right at the deepest part of the imperial forbidden grounds—the Dragon Vein Core.' Mr. Mo's voice carried a rare heaviness. 'She is being used as the formation's eye to suppress the Dragon Vein's agitation, as a Heavenly Fate Key. The method to break the formation... requires guidance from a specific bloodline to lead the Dragon Vein, otherwise if the Dragon Vein loses control, a thousand miles in all directions will turn to scorched earth.'

'There is one more thing.' Mr. Mo fell silent for a moment. 'The imperial edict was personally issued by the emperor. This man's cultivation reaches the heavens, his schemes run deep. Treating a weak woman like this... there must be a greater scheme behind it. You must be careful. This clue may lead to far more than just a forbidden land.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his gaze interweaving anticipation and composure into a complex light. The illusory interface of the Tianji Record faded, while the servant disciples still carried water and chopped firewood, utterly unaware of the upheavals that had just occurred in that Void. And his sister was in the Dragon Vein's depths within the imperial forbidden grounds—as close as it had ever been, yet as far as it had ever seemed. Restrictions, guards, imperial soldiers... He had to find a way, a way that went undetected.

Chen Ji closed his eyes again, the fragments of the Tianji Record turning in his consciousness. Information about the imperial forbidden grounds flooded in like a tide—it was the core of the imperial dynasty's accumulated fortune spanning thousands of years, guarded by elite soldiers at the peak of Nascent Soul Transformation stage. Even cultivators at the Great Ascension stage could not break through head-on. But forbidden grounds were not impenetrable—where there was a door, there was a crack. He gently curved his lips, the light of anticipation burning in his eyes.

dialogue.content: 'Xiao Nian has been afraid of the dark and being alone since she was little.' Chen Ji's voice was very soft, yet carried a chilling coldness that made one's back shiver. 'She's been locked up for so long, she must be so scared... Brother is late.' He gently exhaled, forcefully suppressing the churning emotions. Impatience was foolish; he was never foolish. He needed helpers, needed intelligence, needed a foolproof infiltration route.

He thought of one person. Ye Qing—the Holy Sect Saintess of the Demonic Path. She possessed the Demonic Path mist that could conceal the Tianji Record's aura; more importantly, the Demonic Path had deeply cultivated in the imperial capital for hundreds of years, with an intelligence network spread throughout the palace forbidden grounds. He took out a purple-black Jade Pendant from his sleeve—it's a contract token, with pale purple light flowing on its surface. As long as he could contact her, the imperial forbidden grounds' defense layout would no longer be a secret.

text.content: Chen Ji immersed his consciousness into the third page of the Tianji Record, a pale purple contract thread faintly visible in the Void. He followed the thread to transmit his intention: 'Ye Qing, I need you to help me with something.' After a moment, a languid yet playful female voice rang in his mind: 'Oh, missing me already? Tell me, what has you in such a hurry?'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's figure condensed in the Void, that alluring yet dangerous face showing a playful smile: 'The imperial forbidden grounds... Chen Ji, your appetite keeps growing. That's the heart of the imperial dynasty, guarded by elite soldiers at the peak of Nascent Soul Transformation. How do you plan to get in?' Her fingertip traced in the Void, and a complex defense map of the forbidden grounds slowly emerged—formation patterns, patrol routes, shift change times, detailed enough to be astonishing. 'This is all the intelligence I've gathered over the years, plus这一次... will this be enough for you?'

text.content: On the defense map, the Dragon Vein entrance was marked at the most central location, with dense annotations beside it. Chen Ji stared at that point, a burning fire kindling in his heart—that was where Xiao Nian was. But just then, a powerful aura fluctuation suddenly came from the direction of the imperial capital. Ye Qing's expression slightly changed: 'Someone is prying into the Tianji Record's aura! The imperial forbidden grounds' restriction is extremely sensitive. That fluctuation just now...'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing quickly wrapped the Tianji Record's aura with the Demonic Path mist, and the pressure of that prying gradually faded. She softly said: 'The Demonic Path mist can only conceal for a while. The imperial forbidden grounds' restriction is extremely keen... You need to act quickly. There are three routes to infiltrate the forbidden grounds. The first—cooperate with certain factions inside the imperial dynasty who are dissatisfied with the emperor, use their strength to create a gap. The second—use the Demonic Path's intelligence network in the imperial capital to find a secret underground passage. The third—directly use the Tianji Record to predict gaps, forcing through with speed and time difference.'

choice.prompt: The guard force of the imperial forbidden grounds consisted of elite soldiers at the peak of Nascent Soul Transformation stage. Chen Ji alone could hardly break through. He had to infiltrate the forbidden grounds and rescue his sister without alerting the imperial dynasty.

choices.description: The imperial dynasty is not monolithic. Certain factions harbor dissatisfaction about the emperor's Dragon Vein plan. Contact them, let them act as proxies, create chaos, then slip through the opening.
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose part of the plan in exchange for internal faction cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Internal coordination lowers the elite soldiers' vigilance, greatly improving success rate
choices.risk_hint: May expose operational intentions, allowing the imperial dynasty to follow the trail

text.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, his eyes gleaming: 'Inside the imperial dynasty... there are indeed forces silently gathering strength. This path is slower, but the most stable.' He began to outline the relationship map of the imperial dynasty's various factions in his mind, searching for the most suitable piece to cooperate with.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing raised her brow with a light laugh: 'Smart. Those old foxes in the imperial dynasty love to see the emperor humiliated. If you can offer enough筹码, they'll be very willing to open a crack for you. However—' she glanced meaningfully at Chen Ji, 'What will the筹码 be?'

choices.text: Take the Secret Passage to Infiltrate
choices.description: The Demonic Path has operated in the imperial capital for hundreds of years. They must have secret routes unknown to others. No matter how strictly the imperial forbidden grounds are guarded, they cannot block every leak.
choices.visible_cost: Completely dependent on Ye Qing's intelligence. If the intelligence is wrong, it will lead to a desperate situation
choices.visible_reward: Avoid the substantial, strike the virtual. Reach the Dragon Vein core via the shortest path, greatly shortening action time
choices.risk_hint: The secret passage may have already been discovered by the imperial dynasty and set with ambushes
choices.process_label: 利用魔道情报网寻找隐秘通道

text.content: Chen Ji毫不犹豫 chose the second path without hesitation: 'The secret passage—the faster, the better. I've waited long enough.' His tone was calm, yet carried an unyielding determination that brooked no refusal.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was slightly startled, then showed a genuine smile: 'I like your decisiveness. The Demonic Path has an ancient passage in the imperial capital, an old river channel left from when the Dragon Vein lost control a thousand years ago. The imperial dynasty doesn't know of its existence... but there's Dragon Vein aura leaking from the entrance. You must be prepared to withstand that aura.'

choices.text: Infiltrate via Tianji Record Gap Prediction
choices.description: No matter how strict the forbidden grounds, the guards cannot maintain highest alert at all times. Use the Tianji Record to predict shift change gaps, cross the outer perimeter at extreme speed, and strike directly at the core.
choices.visible_cost: Each prediction consumes 5 Heavenly Fate points. If the prediction is wrong, it will be catastrophic
choices.visible_reward: Completely control the initiative, dependent on no one. The result would be most satisfying
choices.risk_hint: Consumes Heavenly Fate points. There are many variables inside the forbidden grounds, and the margin for error is almost zero

text.content: A cold sharpness flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: 'No need to be so troublesome. The forbidden grounds' shift change times have gaps. I can calculate them.' He flipped his hand to take out a fragment, Tianji Record's aura flowing at his fingertips. The cost to predict the next three hours—10 Heavenly Fate points. Worth it.

dialogue.content: Mr. Mo's voice suddenly sounded, carrying a rare warning: 'Master, Heavenly Fate points are already below thirty. Every prediction is透支 your lifespan... Please reconsider.' Chen Ji did not answer, only gently stroking the blurred inscriptions on the fragment. Lifespan? His lifespan was originally meant to exchange for Xiao Nian's life.

Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji for a moment, then suddenly spoke softly: 'You know, the first time I saw you, I felt you were different from everyone else.' Her voice lost some of its playfulness, gaining a hint of seriousness. 'There's something in your eyes... like someone who has long seen through the direction of fate, yet still chooses to walk forward to meet it.'

She put away the defense map, flicked her fingers, and a set of pitch-black secret passage coordinates appeared before Chen Ji's eyes: 'The entrance is in an abandoned well thirty li outside the imperial capital. Dragon Vein aura seeps from the well's bottom. Follow the aura downward, about one hour to reach the formation wall at the edge of the forbidden grounds. The formation patterns there are the weakest. With your abilities, opening a crack won't be difficult.' She paused, 'I will provide reconnaissance on the outer perimeter as much as possible, but after going deep... that will be up to you.'

text.content: Chen Ji took the coordinates, firmly carving them into the Tianji Record's memory. He looked at Ye Qing and said seriously: 'Ye Qing, I'll remember this favor.' Ye Qing waved her hand, but as she turned, she looked back, a complex light flickering in her eyes: 'Chen Ji, you must bring her out.' Her voice was soft, 'The feeling of being forgotten by loved ones... I know it too well.'

The contract thread dissipated, and Chen Ji's consciousness returned to reality. He stood under the eaves of the Servants' Quarters, gazing toward the direction of the imperial capital, where the clouds hung low and the Dragon Vein's aura was faintly visible. Xiao Nian, wait a little longer. Brother is coming soon. His fingers trembled slightly, that long-suppressed anticipation finally finding an outlet. The imperial forbidden grounds, elite soldiers at the peak of Nascent Soul Transformation, his sister deep within the Dragon Vein—this game of chess has just begun.
